units.rawText: The insane mad scientist, Steins Gate... They're nothing more than make-believe. I know that very well myself.
units.displayText: The insane mad scientist, Steins Gate... They're nothing more than make-believe. I know that very well myself.

spans.text: The insane mad scientist, Steins Gate... They're nothing more than make-believe. I know that very well myself.

units.rawText: But these chuuni delusions are my weapons and armor which have allowed me to help and save the people important to me in countless critical situations.
units.displayText: But these chuuni delusions are my weapons and armor which have allowed me to help and save the people important to me in countless critical situations.

units.rawText: How's that? It was a cool line, right? O comrade of mine, don't make such a pitying face... Still, you understand me, right?
units.displayText: How's that? It was a cool line, right? O comrade of mine, don't make such a pitying face... Still, you understand me, right?

spans.text: How's that? It was a cool line, right? O comrade of mine, don't make such a pitying face... Still, you understand me, right?

units.rawText: After all, you're just like me, playing a role to protect the people important to you, are you not?
